test_integer_dtype_construction: test that nullable integer dtypes like Int8 and UInt32 construct correctly with proper signedness and name
test_aggregate_ops_preserve_dtype: test that sum, min, max, prod operations on nullable integer arrays preserve dtype through groupby
test_astype_conversions: test converting nullable integer Series to same dtype, numpy dtype, object, floating, datetime, and boolean dtypes
test_astype_copy_behavior: test that astype with copy=True creates independent copies and copy=False shares memory for nullable integer arrays
test_to_numpy_conversion: test converting nullable integer arrays to numpy with various dtypes, na_value handling, and readonly flags
